answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 8619 Country: India Title: Asslam allekum.main ek ladki se dus saal se mohabbat karta hu wo bhi mujhse mohabbat karti hai maine aisa suna tha ki agar ladka ladki dono raazi ho to aapas main bina kisi gawah or waqeel ke Nikah ho jata hamne aisa kiya hai maine us se pucha aapko kabool hai usne kaha kabool hai ab aap ye batayen ki hamara nikah kabool hua ya nahi main badi muskil main hu Question: Asslam allekum.main ek ladki se dus saal se mohabbat karta hu wo bhi mujhse mohabbat karti hai maine aisa suna tha ki agar ladka ladki dono raazi ho to aapas main bina kisi gawah or waqeel ke Nikah ho jata hamne aisa kiya hai maine us se pucha aapko kabool hai usne kaha kabool hai ab aap ye batayen ki hamara nikah kabool hua ya nahi main badi muskil main hu Answer ID: 8619 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1348/196=TL/1429) Nikah takes place at least with two witnesses; otherwise it will not be valid. Only by exchanging qubool hai, the Nikah shall not take place. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
